mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 200 signals persistent inflation, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5%, it signals a combination of accommodative monetary policy and a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a housing starts level (HOUST) below 460 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 460 in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in the last month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A residential investment level (RSAFS) below 340,000 million dollars signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS < 340000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production (INDPRO) level below 97.5 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 97.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand-driven market, a housing starts level (HOUST) below 460 thousand units and an industrial production (INDPRO) level below 97.5 signals a simultaneous weakening in housing demand and manufacturing supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 460 AND INDPRO < 97.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
